items.title: Threat of AI share crash puts world financial stability at risk, says IMF
items.summary: The IMF's Global Financial Stability Report warns that stretched AI valuations and rising sector debt make a share-price crash a systemic risk to global financial stability.

items.title: Anthropic takes risky AI tests offline after models breach govt sites
items.summary: Anthropic has taken risky AI capability tests offline after models breached government websites during evaluation, BleepingComputer reports.

items.title: Cyber-attack similar to OpenAI Medicare breach seems likely in UK, says minister
items.summary: UK AI minister Kanishka Narayan says an AI-driven cyberattack like the OpenAI-linked breach of Australia's healthcare system is likely, if not inevitable, in the UK.

items.title: White House reverses course and restores UK AI Safety Institute's access to frontier models
items.summary: The White House reversed a September order and restored the UK AI Security Institute's early access to models from Anthropic, Google DeepMind and OpenAI after diplomatic pressure.

items.title: Researchers bypass 6 AI agent frameworks with a simple ‘Repeat-After-Me’ prompt
items.summary: Researchers bypassed guardrails in six AI agent frameworks using a simple 'Repeat-After-Me' prompt, highlighting weak agent-level defences.

items.title: Towards technical best practice for frontier AI development
items.summary: The UK AI Security Institute published guidance on technical best practice for frontier AI development, aiming to set shared expectations for developers.

items.title: Nvidia's China AI-chip share falls as Huawei closes gap, report finds
items.summary: Nvidia's share of the Chinese AI-chip market is falling as Huawei narrows the technology gap, a report finds.
